scope: Verify the current ParetoJev hypothesis on real 27K data and the established project baseline variants; not make it win or finish serving/student research.

no_jev_primary_and_cmr_controls.evidence: 18 checkpoint hashes and real checkpoint channel-invariance checks in independent_verification.json

same_jev_and_no_jev_factorial_controls.evidence: all eight registered/sanity comparisons in independent_verification.json

common_inputs_and_temporal_boundaries.evidence: cohort_audit.json; independent_verification.json; base/full equality and candidate/objective identity checks

same_registered_budgets_and_validation_o.evidence: 20 epochs per arm and earliest validation maximum checked for all 18 checkpoints; epoch 0 retained

unchanged_weighted_evaluator_and_gates.evidence: independent weighted objective/cold/control/regret arithmetic; exact same front/reference HV refinement

uncertainty_and_negative_results.evidence: all three seed evaluation reports and paired intervals; README explicitly discloses instability and limits

limitations: Retrospective logged pseudo-slates, not online causal uplift.
One fixed recipe, three seeds; no proof of architecture upper bounds.
No full retraining or cross-hardware bitwise replay claimed.
